responsibility: Contains the main semantic-action and code-generation API that the COBOL parser calls to build GCC GENERIC for COBOL programs. It implements parser_* routines for statements, variables, files, calls, intrinsics, control flow, program/file entry and exit, runtime support variable creation, and many statement-specific lowerings, translating parsed COBOL constructs and symbol-table objects into front-end trees and libgcobol runtime calls.
same_name_distinction: Implements the parser_* code-generation entry points declared in genapi.h. Unlike the header, this .cc file contains the executable lowering logic that turns parsed COBOL constructs into GCC trees and runtime calls.
